notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
* Added super jump mode.
# If you clear all stages, you will be able to play “Super Jump” mode, which will double your jumping power.

* Improved viewpoint movement a little.

* Fixed a bug that the cursor disappears in certain operations.

* Fixed a bug that caused eggs to fly up abnormally.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
* Added the explanation of operation method of pause and view change.
* Fixed where the eggs stuck completely and could not move.
* Fixed an issue where eggs suddenly became black at certain places.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
* Lowered the volume of music and sound effects a little.
* Fixed the problem that you can not operate the menu when using the controller.
* Fixed an issue where game over would occur if life was lost at the same time as game clear.
